subject.title: [Bug]: qqbot + ollama + local model: qwen3.5:27b report: error Embedded agent failed before reply: LLM request failed: network connection was interrupted

question: For QQBot local Ollama runs, should a provider ECONNRESET before the configured provider timeout be treated as an OpenClaw retry/recovery gap or as an upstream local-server failure that requires server-log confirmation?
rationale: Current main already fixed the old QQBot watchdog cap and classifies the reported transport text, so an automated fix would have to choose a recovery policy that affects long-running local models and stuck-session behavior.

options.title: Keep Open For Live Repro
options.body: Ask for a current-main QQBot/Ollama run with redacted OpenClaw diagnostics and Ollama/server logs before changing timeout or retry policy.

options.title: Treat As External Reset
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide ECONNRESET is expected upstream/server behavior and the docs troubleshooting path is sufficient without an OpenClaw code change.

options.title: Define OpenClaw Recovery
options.body: Sponsor a focused fix that retries or delays failure for local-provider transport resets and proves both long-model and genuine-reset behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Live Repro
recommendation.body: Ask for a current-main QQBot/Ollama run with redacted OpenClaw diagnostics and Ollama/server logs before changing timeout or retry policy.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz approved the prior QQBot timeout fix and is the best available human owner for the remaining compatibility-visible timeout/recovery decision.
